claims: The Artemis 2 mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The SLS rocket carried four astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen in the Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis 2 mission is a 10-day trip around the Moon.
The Artemis 2 crew is currently in space.
The Orion capsule has successfully deployed its solar arrays.
The Artemis 2 mission is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
The Artemis 2 mission aims to test systems for future moon landings.
Shortly after launch, the Artemis 2 crew reported a minor glitch with the space toilet (Universal Waste Management System).
The Artemis 2 mission continues as planned.
